scope: Reconcile existing normal-state horizontal GTK2 arrow comparisons with the SR10.4/VUE reference, without repeating captures or sending input to the VM.

evidence.scope: Normal GTK2 theme assets, four directions across three variants.
evidence.result: 12 cells matched the retained Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE 2.01 cells at 0/225 differing pixels each; the DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE left/right assets were 15x15.

evidence.scope: Fresh GTK2 2.24.33 rendering using the selected installed DomainOS theme.
evidence.result: All four normal 15x15 cells, including left and right, matched the retained SR10.4/VUE sample at 0/225 differing pixels. The report did not reproduce a narrower horizontal arrow.

evidence.scope: Current normal horizontal cells in the live VUE screenshot against the retained VUE crop.
evidence.result: Both 15x15 cells matched at 0/225 differing pixels.

evidence.scope: Real public GTK2 preview route in private Xvfb/bwrap.
evidence.result: Each normal arrow ROI matched its generated asset at 0 differing pixels; each direction changed 53 pixels while held and returned to hover exactly on release. The preview recipe remained partial and was not installed.

conclusion: The reported normal-state horizontal arrow width reduction is not reproduced by the retained GTK2 assets or the recorded fresh GTK2 rendering. Existing 15x15 geometry is supported; these results do not justify a geometry change.
limits: R305/R394 cover normal GTK2 cells; R683's held/released state is GTK2 behavior, not a held-state comparison against the historical VM.
